purpose: Map canonical Convergence Guard rules to the frozen v0.1.7 harness and the post-benchmark v0.2 implementation target.

status_values.FULL: Executable behavior and auditable artifact exist for the rule.
status_values.PARTIAL: Some behavior exists, but the canonical rule is incomplete or depends on caller-supplied guarantees.
status_values.MISSING: Canonical behavior was absent and could be silently skipped.
status_values.FAIL_CLOSED: The v0.2 harness does not fully implement the branch but must mark protocol completion partial/budget-stopped instead of claiming completion.
status_values.NOT_APPLICABLE: Rule does not apply to that mode.

rules.note: v0.2 requires self-contained provenance rules, but a dedicated machine-verifiable A1 claim table is not yet mandatory in execute_full_v02.
v0.2 preserves the contract but completeness of deadline/default/cost-of-delay remains a caller obligation.
Independent reframe/retrospective optional branches are not yet fully executable in cg_v02_workflow.
Fresh stateless calls; isolated inputs contain evidence/contract/framing/own mandate only.
Expansion workers do not receive prior branch outputs.
Neutral IDs are model-visible; source-stage map is coordinator/audit only.
No mapper output or branch identity in prompt.
No C1 output/ranking/danger flags in prompt.

rules.v0.2_artifact: C3-boundary.json when C2 triggers; explicit skip otherwise
rules.note: A triggered C3 cannot disappear silently.

rules.rule: C4 decision-relevant slate; zero/one finalist allowed; no padding
rules.note: v0.1.7 used a hidden fixed ranking and fail-soft non-FAIL fallback; v0.2 uses explicit slate adjudication and permits zero finalists.

rules.rule: C4 targeted checkpoint for missing family/evidence
rules.note: Shares finite corrective-cycle budget.
One finalist per isolated dossier worker.
Revisions do not inherit the old candidate's validation.

rules.v0.2_artifact: information_probe_id in C4 + E next-test path
rules.note: Dedicated probe mini-dossier is not separately implemented; if elaboration is required beyond E, the run must not claim that optional stage occurred.

rules.rule: optional premortem/stakeholder lenses and upstream routing
rules.note: Not silently counted as complete. A future v0.2.x implementation may add triggered artifacts.
v0.2 prompt carries the operation explicitly.
No specially labeled outside alternative is injected.

rules.rule: D2 pairwise collision only on decision conflict
rules.note: Explicitly preserves COEXIST/INTERACTING without forced winner duel.
v0.2 hides D2 pairwise preferences and coordinator favorite.

rules.v0.2_artifact: protocol ledger material omission + action conflict
rules.note: v0.2 currently fail-closes unresolved decision-changing challenge instead of pretending reconciliation; full upstream reroute remains an implementation target.

rules.rule: E1 separate model judgment from action judgment
rules.note: COEXIST may remain resolved while action is deferred.
Unresolved decision-changing D2/D3 conflict is carried as material omission rather than winner selection.
Schema no longer forces an invented test.

rules.rule: protocol completion must reflect actually executed stages
rules.note: Harness, not model prose, determines COMPLETE/PARTIAL_PROTOCOL/BUDGET_STOP.
No inaccessible 'see protocol §...' dependency is required for participant compliance.
